subject: Tufts University Boston Avenue Housing Project
overview: The board recommended approval of the Mystic Avenue Corridor District zoning amendments to the City Council and reviewed a site plan for a 677-bed Tufts University dormitory. The Tufts proposal was continued to December 18 to allow for additional data on shadow impacts and further discussion of a proposed community fund.

items.title: Call to Order and Procedural Matters
items.summary: Chair Jacqueline McPherson opened the remote meeting and conducted roll call attendance.

items.title: 21 St. Clair Road Site Plan Review
items.summary: Approved a written request to continue the public hearing for a Dover amendment site plan review to December 18, 2024.

items.title: Mystic Avenue Corridor District Zoning Amendment
items.summary: Voted to recommend the City Council approve the Mystic Avenue Corridor District zoning amendments with modifications to LEED standards, ground floor use requirements, and affordability tables. The proposal aims to transform the corridor into a walkable, mixed-use district with simplified dimensional standards.

items.title: 401 Boston Avenue Tufts Student Housing
items.summary: Continued the public hearing for a 10-story, 677-bed dormitory project after hearing significant public concern regarding shadows, light pollution, and delivery traffic. Tufts representatives proposed a $500,000 community fund to mitigate impacts, but the board requested more detailed shadow comparisons and legal clarification on Dover amendment restrictions.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Adjournment
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from October 30, 2024, and adjourned the meeting.
